target.name: Nomura Partners Funds, Inc. The Japan Fund (NPF Japan Fund)

listed_quote.quote: The advisor to the Funds, Nomura Asset Management USA, has decided to exit the U.S. retail open-end mutual fund business.

announcement.quote: The Reorganization Agreement may be terminated and the Japan Fund Reorganization abandoned at any time prior to the Closing Date by a determination of either the NPF Board or the Matthews Board that the Japan Fund Reorganization is no longer in the best interests of shareholders.

deals.notes: Target is an open-end mutual fund per the quote; Matthews Japan Fund is a series of the registrant Matthews International Funds (CIK 923184 is the registrant's CIK, not a separate series CIK). The September 10, 2014 meeting outcome is not stated in the excerpts. The 2015 proxy filings (seq 12-16) are compact and do not show what they concern. The N-14 also names a High Yield Fund of Nomura Partners Funds but no merger of it is described in the excerpts.

problems: Outcome not stated. Compact excerpts of the 2014-08 to 2015-12 DEFA14A and proxy filings show only headers.
